title: Which predictive question does a mixed IPD and aggregate leave-one-out elpd answer, and does PSIS approximate it at the unit that matters?
question: In a likelihood that mixes patient-level and arm-level terms, how does the elpd depend on the unit held out, does PSIS-LOO match the exact leave-unit-out value at the patient, arm and study units, and does the choice of unit change which model is selected?
design: Six-study ML-NMR with an identity link and known variances, so exact leave-unit-out refits are closed form; PSIS-LOO on exact posterior draws at the pointwise, arm and study units for a correctly and an incorrectly specified interaction model, across IPD proportion, heterogeneity and one high-leverage study. 12 cells, 400 replicates each.
